name: dsdv_mu_hwin-dsdv_mu_hwin-COMMIT
purpose: MU-S81-2: multi-user end-slice window / replay / RX tag leaf dsdv_mu_hwin (NSLOT 47, NEV 8) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_mu_hwin #(.NSLOT(47), .NEV(8), .NEP(4), .NRT(2), .MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/unit/dsdv_mu_hwin.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_hwin/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_hwin/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_hwin --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_mu_hwin  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: MU-S81-2/DIE 10-19 (RTL fixed by MU-S81-2/SEQ 5dd45e769: slot gap table, entries wrap at the calendar's slot count): NEW leaf dsdv_mu_hwin beside the dsdv_mu_hslot leaf in the MU seq_host master (dsdv_seq_host_mux): the end-slice TX tag windows (mu_c per end slice), landing replays (mu_rc) and RX tag check (mu_rt) of the multi-user S81 die, from its own start table copy (same f_ks start tap, same f_mc S / RL / gap words) and its own boot word stream f_mw (host CSR 0x16), NSLOT 47 x NEV 8 events, NEP 4 end slices, NRT 2 returning end slices. Every event fires at a fixed offset D after its user's start edge (no queue / ready / credit). Faces: taps + boot words W (beside seq_host), mu_c / mu_rc / mu_rt / t_wf E (to the end-slice die wires and the t_mf fold), ck / rst_n S. Kit rules: recipe 4 flop-first, reset_landing 2, io_hold_margin 0.025, M5 cap.
